summary: Lamotrigine row is largely factually supported, including FDA approval year, US availability, adverse-event percentages, labeled formulations, mechanism text, half-life, glucuronidation metabolism, boxed-warning text, and most plotted RCT outcome values. Updates are needed for black-box source metadata, mechanism/QT filters, XR maximum daily dose, source hygiene, PubMed aliases, and missing Matsuo1993 RCT/outcome coverage. No duplicate separate-drug row is indicated for aliases.
